name: Joel Dutton
career_history: Preconstruction Manager at Evans General Contractors, 12/2025 to present; Preconstruction Manager at TDIndustries, 6/2025 to 12/2025; Senior Estimator at TDIndustries, 1/2025 to 6/2025; Construction Estimator at TDIndustries, 7/2021 to 1/2025; Project Management Intern at TDIndustries, 6/2019 to 8/2019; Foreman at TDIndustries, 4/2018 to 7/2021; Journeyman Welder at TDIndustries, 5/2015 to 4/2018; Squad Leader at Adventures In Missions, 1/2011 to 5/2013
education: Bachelor of Science - BS, Construction Engineering Technologies, Southern Miss School of Construction and Design, 2019 to 2023
biography:
I’m a Preconstruction Manager – Advanced Technology at Evans General Contractors, specializing in mission-critical facilities: hyperscale data centers, semiconductor fabs, and life-science/pharmaceutical projects. I combine leadership experience, a strong field background, and mechanical/plumbing preconstruction expertise to help deliver complex advanced technology and mission-critical projects.

I spent seven years in the field as a welder, pipe fitter, piping foreman and Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) before graduating Summa Cum Laude from The University of Southern Mississippi. That hands-on foundation shapes how I approach preconstruction—aligning design intent with real-world constructability.

I’m also deeply invested in leadership development and skilled trades advocacy, mentoring future tradespeople and speaking publicly about the powerful career paths available in our industry.

In all my work, I bridge the gap between craft, leadership, and preconstruction to ensure projects are planned with precision and built with pride.
